notes: Boolean; institution-level attribute. Source: Home Office "Register of licensed sponsors: students". Pair with `ukvi_sponsor_status` for probationary / revoked detail.

possible_values: {status: Student Sponsor / Probationary Sponsor / Legacy Sponsor / suspended / revoked, track_record_of_compliance: boolean, sponsor_name_on_register: string, verified_at: date}
definition: The detailed status of the institution's Student sponsor licence as it appears on the Home Office register, including whether it holds a track record of compliance (which unlocks lower-evidence differentiation).
notes: Sponsor name on the register may differ from the trading name; store it for CAS matching.

full_name: SEVP certification and SEVIS school code (US)
possible_values: {school_code: "BOS214F00312000", sevp_certified: boolean, f1_authorised: boolean, m1_authorised: boolean, verified_at: date}
definition: The institution's SEVIS school code and SEVP certification status, without which it cannot issue Form I-20.
notes: Source: ICE SEVP school search. Campus-specific codes exist for multi-campus institutions; store the primary and list others on the Campus row.

possible_values: HLC / MSCHE / WSCUC / SACSCOC / NECHE / NWCCU / ACCJC / national_accreditor / none
definition: The recognised institutional accreditor of a US institution; former "regional" accreditation is the quality signal students and Nepal MoE look for.
notes: Source: CHEA / US Dept of Education DAPIP. Programmatic accreditation (ABET, AACSB) is course-level in `course.md`.

possible_values: {provider_code: "7001", category: 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / university / Te Pukenga, signatory_code_of_practice: boolean, verified_at: date}
definition: The institution's NZQA provider code, External Evaluation and Review category (1 = highly confident, 4 = not confident) and whether it is a signatory to the Code of Pastoral Care, all required for international enrolment.
notes: Category affects Immigration NZ processing and post-study work rights for some sub-degree levels (see `post-study-migration.md`).

possible_values: {mqa_code: string, mohe_licence: string, emgs_registered: boolean, setara_rating: 1-6 or null, verified_at: date}
definition: Malaysian Qualifications Agency accreditation identifiers, Ministry of Higher Education licence, EMGS registration (needed for the Visa Approval Letter) and SETARA rating tier.
notes: Branch campuses of AU / UK universities in MY hold their own MQA codes.

possible_values: {anabin_id: string, anabin_status: H+ / H- / H+/-, hochschulkompass_listed: boolean, state_recognised: boolean, verified_at: date}
definition: Recognition status of a German institution in the anabin database (H+ = recognised university) and its listing in the HRK Hochschulkompass, which together tell a student the degree will be recognised at home and abroad.
notes: Private Hochschulen must be state-recognised (staatlich anerkannt); record the Land granting recognition.

possible_values: {cao_code: string, hea_designated: boolean, qqi_provider: boolean, trusted_ireland_mark: boolean, ilep_listed_legacy: boolean, verified_at: date}
definition: Irish identifiers: CAO institution code, HEA designation (public), QQI provider status, and the TrustEd Ireland international education mark (successor to ILEP) that a provider needs for non-EEA student visas.
notes: The ILEP closed for new listings when TrustEd Ireland launched; keep the legacy flag while the transition runs.

possible_values: {khda_permit: string, caa_licensed: boolean, caa_accredited_programs_only: boolean, free_zone: DIAC / DKP / RAKEZ / ADGM / none, verified_at: date}
definition: For UAE campuses: the KHDA (Dubai) or ADEK (Abu Dhabi) permit and whether the institution or its programs hold federal Commission for Academic Accreditation licensing, which determines recognition inside the UAE and in the home country.
notes: Many free-zone branch campuses are KHDA-permitted but not CAA-accredited; degrees are then recognised by the home university's regulator, not UAE federally. Explain carefully.

possible_values: {mhesi_code: string, type: public / autonomous / private / rajabhat / rajamangala, ohec_accredited: boolean, verified_at: date}
definition: Thai Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation registration and institution type.
notes: Low volume market; annual check is sufficient.

possible_values: {scheme: TPS (AU) / Public Trust or SFPT (NZ) / TrustEd Ireland learner protection (IE) / OfS student protection plan (GB) / provincial fund e.g. Ontario TCAF (CA) / none, member: boolean, verified_at: date}
definition: Which statutory scheme would refund or place the student if the institution collapsed or lost its licence; a key reassurance item for private colleges.
notes: AU: all CRICOS providers are TPS members automatically.

definition: The most recent date on which every applicable registration object above was re-checked against its official register; drives the "verified as of" line Edge prints.
notes: Minimum of the `verified_at` values across the destination's applicable registration rows.

full_name: Nepal MoE No Objection Certificate eligible
definition: Whether Nepal's Ministry of Education, Science and Technology issues a No Objection Certificate (NOC) for study at this institution, which Nepali students need to remit fees legally through banks.
notes: NOC is issued per student and course, but MoE refuses for unaccredited institutions; record the institution-level eligibility and any known refusal pattern in `notable_risks`. Origin-side procedure lives in `source-country-grading.md` / `fees-and-money.md`.

definition: Whether degrees from the institution are granted equivalence by the Association of Indian Universities for further study or public employment in India (requires the institution to be recognised in its home country and, for some countries, a minimum duration).
notes: AIU generally excludes degrees delivered wholly online, by distance or via franchised twinning; flag such providers.

definition: Whether the University Grants Commission of Bangladesh recognises degrees from the institution for equivalence, which Bangladeshi graduates need for government jobs and further study at home.
notes: Bangladesh Bank student-file remittance rules are in `fees-and-money.md`.

definition: Generic home-country recognition of the institution's degrees for origins not covered by the specific rows (VN MOET, PH CHED, LK UGC), keyed by nationality.
notes: Extend with a per-origin row when an origin becomes a Tier 1 market.

definition: Position in the QS World University Rankings for the stated edition year; store the exact rank where given or the band string where QS publishes bands only.
notes: Always quote with the edition year. Unranked institutions store `rank: null, band: "unranked"`.

definition: Position or band in the Times Higher Education World University Rankings for the stated edition.
notes: Same conventions as `qs_world_rank`.

definition: Position or band in the Academic Ranking of World Universities; research-weighted, useful for PhD applicants.
notes: Mainly used for research-degree conversations.

full_name: US News Best Global Universities rank
definition: Position in US News Best Global Universities; the ranking US-bound families most often cite, also used for US national rank when present.
notes: Store US News national (Best Colleges) rank in `national_rank` with publication "US News".

possible_values: {rank: 12, publication: Guardian / Complete University Guide / Times Good University Guide / Maclean's / Good Universities Guide / US News Best Colleges / CHE Ranking / other, edition_year: 2026}
definition: The institution's position in the most-cited domestic league table for its destination, with the publication named so that different tables are not compared.
notes: Maclean's uses three categories (Medical Doctoral, Comprehensive, Primarily Undergraduate); include the category in the publication string.

definition: Subject-level ranking positions for the institution's notable disciplines, used when a student asks "is it good for nursing / IT / business".
notes: Cap at the top-200 subject placings; course-level accreditation is in `course.md`.

definition: Single derived band from the best of QS and THE world rank in the latest edition, used for filtering and for the `gs_top_ranked_flag` rule.
notes: Best-of rule must be documented in the derivation so counsellors can explain it.

possible_values: {overall: Gold / Silver / Bronze / Requires improvement / not_participating, student_experience: Gold / Silver / Bronze, student_outcomes: Gold / Silver / Bronze, year: 2023}
definition: Teaching Excellence Framework award from the Office for Students, the UK's official teaching-quality signal.
notes: TEF 2023 awards run for four years; refresh when the next exercise publishes.

definition: Share of undergraduate international students rating their overall educational experience positively in the latest Student Experience Survey (QILT / ComparED).
notes: Take the international-student cut where published; note the level (UG vs PG).

definition: Institution-level positivity score from the UK National Student Survey (teaching on my course theme or overall measure, as published by OfS), latest year.
notes: NSS changed measures in 2023; record which measure and year.

definition: Whether the US institution publishes its National Survey of Student Engagement results and the headline indicators it reports.
notes: NSSE is not centrally published per institution; expect many `reported: false`.

definition: Share of graduates in employment or further study at the institution level from the official graduate-outcomes survey (QILT GOS, HESA Graduate Outcomes, NZ Employment Outcomes), latest year.
notes: Course-level figure is the seed attribute `graduate_employment_rate` in `course.md`; prefer course-level when present.

definition: Number of students per academic staff member as reported by THE or the national statistics agency.
notes: Course class size is in `course.md`.

possible_values: {score: 4.1, scale: 5, review_count: 1200, platform: Google / StudentCrowd / WhatUni / Niche}
definition: Public crowd-sourced rating of the institution, with the platform and count so weak samples are not over-quoted.
notes: Quote only as "public reviews average" with the platform named.

definition: Total headcount of enrolled students (all levels, all campuses) in the latest reported year.
notes: Sources: AU Dept of Education uCube, HESA, StatCan, IPEDS, university annual report. Store the year in provenance.

definition: Headcount of international (overseas fee-paying) students in the latest reported year.
notes: Same sources as `total_enrolment`.

definition: International students as a percentage of total enrolment, derived from the two counts.
notes: Very high shares (above 50%) at private colleges are a visa-risk signal; see `visa_risk_rating`.

definition: The leading nationalities among international students with their share or count, from official statistics or the institution's own reporting.
notes: AU: Dept of Education publishes per-provider nationality only in aggregate bands; supplement with university annual reports.

full_name: Estimated students from an origin market
definition: Estimated headcount of students from a given origin country (NP / IN / BD / others) currently enrolled, from official data where available or from the institution's international office.
notes: Estimate; Edge phrases via `source_market_presence_band` rather than quoting a number.

full_name: Origin community presence at the institution
definition: Qualitative band derived from `source_market_student_estimate` relative to total international enrolment, safe to state to a student ("there is a large Nepali student community").
notes: Thresholds: large above 300 or above 8% of international cohort; moderate 50-300; small under 50. City-level diaspora is the seed attribute `diaspora_community_presence` in `city-cost-of-living.md`.

definition: Share of applicants who receive an offer, institution-wide or by level where published; a selectivity signal mainly meaningful for US, UK Russell Group and competitive CA programs.
notes: Most AU / NZ institutions do not publish; leave `unknown` rather than infer.

full_name: South Asian and faith student societies
possible_values: nepali_society / indian_society / bangladeshi_society / sri_lankan_society / pakistani_society / islamic_society / hindu_society / sikh_society / south_asian_society / none_found
definition: Registered student clubs relevant to South Asian students, as listed on the student union or clubs directory.
notes: Crawl the student union site (often a separate domain, add to PartnerRecord.domains).

definition: Origin countries in which the institution runs an official alumni chapter or association, a signal of long-standing recruitment and a networking asset for returnees.
notes: Store chapter contact URL in provenance `source_url`.

definition: Expert's internal composite of the institution's visa outcomes for a nationality, combining the destination-specific rows below with observed case outcomes; drives how strongly Edge cautions a counsellor before lodging.
notes: Never quoted to students. Derivation rule documented in `05-priorities.md`; inputs: `au_evidence_level`, `ca_dli_approval_rate_pct`, `uk_bca_status`, `notable_risks`, branch case history (out of scope entity CaseOutcome).

definition: The institution's Simplified Student Visa Framework evidence level, which combined with the student's country risk decides whether financial and English evidence must be lodged with the visa application.
notes: Home Affairs does not publish levels; providers are told their own. Collected via partnerships and industry lists; treat as internal and date-stamped. Country-side risk rating is in `destination-visa.md`.

definition: Whether the institution currently sits in the high-priority processing band under the operative Ministerial Direction (e.g. MD111 prioritises applications until a provider reaches 80% of its indicative allocation).
notes: Changes when the Direction changes or the provider crosses the threshold; couple with `cap_allocation`.

possible_values: {approval_rate_pct: 71, applications: 5400, year: 2024, source: IRCC ATIP release}
definition: The share of study-permit applications naming this DLI that were approved in the latest available IRCC data, obtained via access-to-information releases.
notes: Not official public data; treat as indicative. Never quoted.

definition: Whether the sponsor passed the Home Office BCA (refusal rate under 10%, enrolment above 90%, course completion above 85%) and the metrics where known; a failing sponsor is at risk of losing its licence.
notes: Metrics are not published by UKVI; obtained from sponsor or industry reporting.

full_name: High Potential Individual visa eligible institution (GB)
definition: Whether the institution appears on the UK Global Universities List for the student's graduation year, making its graduates (from any country) eligible for the High Potential Individual visa.
notes: The list is per graduation year and covers non-UK institutions; a student at a listed AU / US university can later move to the UK. Visa terms live in `post-study-migration.md`.

definition: Internal derived flag that the institution sits in the ranking band (default: QS or THE top 300) Expert treats as favourable context in Genuine Student (AU), study-plan / SOP (CA) and credibility-interview (GB) narratives and in destination concessions that reference top-ranked universities.
notes: Threshold configurable; derived from `ranking_band_summary`. Do not state to students as an official category.

possible_values: [{type: sanction / licence_suspension / licence_revocation / cap_breach / financial_distress / campus_closure / adverse_media / regulator_conditions, date, summary, source_url, resolved: boolean}]
definition: Dated log of regulatory sanctions, licence actions, cap breaches, financial warnings, closures or serious adverse media affecting the institution, used to caution counsellors and to explain sudden offer or CoE delays.
notes: Feed from regulator notices (TEQSA, ASQA, OfS, UKVI, IRCC, NZQA) and Google News alerts; `resolved` closes an entry without deleting history.

possible_values: {scheme: AU National Planning Level / CA Provincial Attestation Letter allocation, year: 2026, allocated_places: 3200, used_pct: 64, status: open / near_cap / closed, as_of: date}
definition: The institution's allocation of new international commencements under the destination's cap scheme and how much is used, which determines whether new offers for the intake can still convert to CoE / LOA with attestation.
notes: AU: indicative allocation under NPL / MD111; CA: PAL / TAL quota per DLI from the province. `status` is what counsellors act on. Destination-level cap policy is in `destination-policy.md`.

full_name: Accepts applicants with prior visa refusals
definition: The institution's observed or stated stance on issuing offers to applicants who have a previous student-visa refusal from any country.
notes: Internal; many AU / CA providers screen refusals at GS pre-assessment. Pair with the refusal-history documentation rules in `application-process.md`.

definition: Whether the institution requires financial documents, a genuine-student statement or a background screen from applicants of a given nationality before issuing an offer or CoE / LOA.
notes: Document list itself is a `DocumentRequirement` in `application-process.md`.

possible_values: {required: boolean, stage: pre_offer / pre_coe / pre_cas, format: video / phone / in_person, typical_wait_days: 7}
definition: Whether the institution itself interviews applicants of a nationality before issuing CAS / CoE / LOA, separate from any visa-authority interview.
notes: Visa-authority interview likelihood is in `destination-visa.md`.

full_name: Nationalities that must apply via an agent
definition: Origin countries from which the institution accepts applications only through an approved education agent, not directly from the student.
notes: Empty array means direct applications accepted from everyone; useful for explaining why Expert must lodge.

definition: Whether the institution admits students already in the destination who wish to transfer from another provider, and any conditions (release letter, six-month rule, minimum progression).
notes: Release rules of the *sending* institution are `release_letter_policy`.

possible_values: {charged: boolean, waived_for_partner_agents: boolean, waiver_conditions: text, refundable: boolean}
definition: Whether an application fee is charged for international applicants, whether it is waived for applications lodged by partner agents, and under what conditions.
notes: Fee amount is a `FeeItem` in `fees-and-money.md`. Agent waiver is `internal` because it derives from the partner relationship.

definition: Typical time from application submission to offer.
notes: Whole number of days; indicative. Store the institution's published standard; observed partner-priority timing is `partner_priority_offer_turnaround_days`.

definition: Offer turnaround Expert actually observes for applications lodged via its partner channel, as recorded by branch operations.
notes: Internal observation; quote only as "usually faster than the published standard".

definition: Whether a conditional offer (pending English/academics) is available.
notes: Boolean. Conditions accepted (pending final results, pending English, pending documents) are enumerated in `offer_types_available`.

possible_values: conditional / unconditional / packaged_with_pathway / provisional_pending_final_results / deferred / pre_assessment_letter
definition: The kinds of offer letter the institution issues to international applicants, so counsellors know what document to expect at each step.
notes: Packaged offers bundle English or pathway with the principal course and matter for visa length (see `pathways-articulation.md`).

possible_values: {days: 28, expires_at_rule: "or 2 weeks before orientation, whichever earlier", extension_possible: boolean}
definition: How long an offer remains open for acceptance and deposit payment before it lapses, and whether extensions are granted.
notes: Some institutions express validity as a fixed date per intake; store the rule text.

full_name: CoE / CAS / I-20 / LOA issue turnaround
definition: Typical working days from acceptance and deposit receipt to issue of the visa-supporting enrolment document (CoE in AU, CAS in GB, I-20 in US, LOA plus attestation in CA, Offer of Place in NZ).
notes: Document names per destination are in `destination-visa.md`.

possible_values: {type: fixed_amount / percentage_of_first_year / first_semester_tuition / full_first_year, due_rule: "on acceptance" / "before CoE" / "14 days after offer", refundable: boolean, counts_toward_tuition: boolean}
definition: How the initial tuition deposit is calculated and when it is due, and whether it counts toward tuition; the amount itself is a FeeItem.
notes: Amount in `fees-and-money.md` (`FeeItem` deposit). CA and GB institutions often require full first-year or semester tuition before LOA / CAS.

possible_values: [{trigger: withdrawal_before_start_4w / withdrawal_after_census / course_cancelled_by_provider / visa_refused, refund_pct: 100, admin_fee_deducted: boolean, deadline_rule: text}]
definition: The institution's published refund rules for international students by trigger and timing, as required by the destination's consumer or ESOS-type rules.
notes: Admin fee amount is a FeeItem. Provider-default refunds (course cancelled) are usually 100%.

possible_values: {max_deferrals: 2, max_months: 12, fee_charged: boolean, deposit_carried_forward: boolean, conditions: text}
definition: How many times and how far an offer can be deferred, whether a fee applies and whether the deposit carries forward.
notes: Deferral fee amount is a FeeItem. Visa-refused students often need a deferral to reapply.

definition: Whether tuition is locked for the duration of the course or reviewed annually, and whether increases are capped, so total-cost estimates are honest.
notes: Pair with `annual_fee_increase_typical_pct`.

definition: The indexation rate the institution states or has historically applied to international tuition each year.
notes: Historical rate is derived from year-on-year `ProgramRecord.tuition` differences once history is kept.

definition: Whether installment / payment-plan options are offered.
notes: Boolean. Terms in `payment_plan_terms`.

definition: The structure of the institution's instalment plan for international students: how many payments, how much up front, any surcharge and who qualifies.
notes: Many providers require full semester fees before CoE regardless of later instalments; capture in `eligibility`.

possible_values: flywire / convera / paymytuition / transfermate / western_union_business / bank_tt / credit_card / bpay / direct_debit
definition: The payment platforms and methods the institution accepts for international tuition and deposits, which determine remittance route and FX cost from Nepal / India / Bangladesh.
notes: Origin-side remittance rules (NRB, RBI LRS, Bangladesh Bank student file) are in `fees-and-money.md`.

definition: Whether the institution accepts a provisional degree certificate or mark sheet in place of the final award (common for Indian and Nepali graduates awaiting convocation) for offers and enrolment, and under what conditions.
notes: `required:with_conditions` means accepted subject to final certificate by a deadline; document formats are in `application-process.md`.

definition: Whether the institution accepts a sworn affidavit or gazette notification to reconcile name or date-of-birth discrepancies between passport and academic documents.
notes: Frequent for Nepali students (SLC vs passport spelling). Visa-side treatment is in `destination-visa.md`.

definition: The institution-wide maximum gap between last qualification and intended start it will accept without extra justification, by level; course rows may override.
notes: Course-level override is `study_gap_max_years` in `course.md`. Gap justification documents in `application-process.md`.

definition: The online application system international applicants (or their agents) use.
notes: Distinguish the direct-applicant portal from `agent_portal_url`.

possible_values: e.g. https://agents.uow.edu.au; StudyLink; Salesforce partner portal
definition: The system approved agents use to lodge and track applications, if separate from the student portal.
notes: Credentials and commission terms are out of scope (PartnerAgreement).

possible_values: {email, phone, whatsapp: string or null, hours_local: text, regional_manager_south_asia: string or null}
definition: Public contact details of the international admissions office and, where published, the regional manager covering South Asia.
notes: Only publicly listed contacts; named staff mobile numbers stay out of the catalog.

possible_values: {present: boolean, city: "Kathmandu" / "New Delhi" / "Dhaka", address: text, services: text}
definition: Whether the institution operates an in-country office or regional hub in Nepal, India or Bangladesh where students can attend pre-departure or verification sessions.
notes: Also informs interview logistics (`institution_credibility_interview`).

definition: Link to the current international student prospectus or guide, the document counsellors hand to families.
notes: Store per intake year; ingest as an upload into `kb_documents` when PDF.

possible_values: {offered: boolean, scope: all_first_year_international / undergraduate_only / conditional_on_deadline / none, apply_by_rule: text}
definition: Whether the institution guarantees a place in institution-managed accommodation to new international students and under what conditions.
notes: Per-campus and per-type detail (`accommodation_guarantee_scope`) is in `accommodation-arrival.md`.

definition: Whether the institution or its pathway partner offers an airport reception service to arriving international students.
notes: Cost, booking lead time and eligibility are in `accommodation-arrival.md`.

definition: Number of days of the dedicated international-student orientation programme before or during general orientation week.
notes: Dates per intake are IntakeCalendar rows in `intake-calendar.md`; mandatory flag is in `accommodation-arrival.md`.

possible_values: cv_review / job_board / employer_fairs / internship_placement_team / alumni_mentoring / interview_coaching / post_graduation_access / international_student_specialist / none
definition: What the careers service provides, including whether graduates keep access after finishing and whether there is a specialist for international students' visa-constrained job search.
notes: Store `post_graduation_access` months in provenance quote if published.

possible_values: {available: boolean, free_sessions: integer or null, after_hours_line: boolean, languages: array[string]}
definition: Availability of free or subsidised psychological counselling for students, any session cap, after-hours crisis line and languages offered.
notes: Key reassurance for parents; Nepali / Hindi-speaking counsellors are rare but worth recording.

definition: Whether a disability services unit exists, what adjustments it offers (exam adjustments, note-takers, assistive tech, accessible housing) and what evidence it needs.
notes: Visa health-requirement interplay is in `destination-visa.md`.

possible_values: {available: boolean, types: multi_faith / muslim_prayer_room_with_wudu / chapel / hindu_shrine, campuses: array[string]}
definition: Whether the institution provides on-campus prayer or reflection spaces, and which kinds; a common question from Muslim and Hindu students.
notes: Off-campus religious facilities near each campus are `religious_facilities_nearby` in `campus-location.md`.

definition: Availability of halal-certified food outlets on campus as stated by the institution or its student union.
notes: City-wide halal and vegetarian availability is in `city-cost-of-living.md`.

definition: Whether there is a named international student support unit (distinct from admissions) handling visa compliance, welfare and orientation.
notes: Near-universal at universities; distinguishing for small private colleges.

possible_values: {available: boolean, adviser_type: registered_migration_agent / OISC_regulated / designated_school_official / licensed_immigration_adviser / general_staff, free: boolean}
definition: Whether students can get regulated immigration advice on campus (e.g. UKCISA-guided OISC advisers, AU RMA, US DSO) and whether it is free.
notes: Edge itself never gives migration advice beyond disclaimer level; this row tells students where to get it.

definition: Whether new international students are paired with a current-student mentor or buddy on arrival.
notes: Soft signal for anxious first-time travellers.

full_name: Free academic English and study skills support
definition: Whether enrolled students can access free academic-writing, English and study-skills workshops or one-to-one help.
notes: Academic progression rules are in `academic-rules.md`.

definition: Whether the institution employs students in on-campus roles (library, ambassadors, hospitality, research assistance), a low-risk first job that in the US is the only off-permit work allowed.
notes: Visa work-hour caps are in `life-and-work-rights.md`.

definition: Institution-wide childcare provision or priority access for students with children; complements the per-campus centre flag.
notes: Per-campus centre and waitlist is `childcare_on_campus` in `campus-location.md`; dependant schooling rules in `family-dependants.md`.

definition: Whether Expert Education is publicly an authorised representative of the institution, applies through an aggregator, or has no relationship; only the public yes/no fact, never commercial terms.
notes: Commission and contract terms are the out-of-scope `PartnerAgreement` entity. `PartnerRecord.enabled/verified` are crawl flags, not partner status.

definition: A short factual description of the institution (type, location, size, strengths) that Edge may quote verbatim to a student.
notes: Generated from the rows above and reviewed by data_team; regenerate when rankings or registrations change.

definition: Expert's internal positioning notes: who the institution suits, how to pitch it against comparable providers, and which student profiles it accepts readily, by origin market.
notes: Internal; Edge uses it to shape recommendations, never quotes it.

possible_values: e.g. ["Regional Cat 2 campus: extra 485 year", "Industry placement in every degree", "Guaranteed housing"]
definition: Bullet list of the strongest, source-backed reasons a counsellor would recommend the institution, each traceable to a catalog row.
notes: Each bullet must cite the attribute id it rests on in provenance.

possible_values: e.g. ["Housing shortage near main campus", "Slow CoE in peak season", "Large class sizes in first year"]
definition: Recurring negatives raised in student reviews, branch feedback or media that a counsellor should pre-empt honestly.
notes: Internal framing aid; public-safe facts behind each concern should exist as their own rows.

possible_values: required / not_required / unknown (store as eligible / not_eligible / conditional)
definition: Whether graduates of this designated learning institution (and, since Nov 2024, of this program field for college credentials) are eligible for the Canadian Post-Graduation Work Permit.
notes: IRCC DLI list flags PGWP eligibility per DLI; public-private partnership college programs lost eligibility in 2024. Course-level field-of-study eligibility is `A.psw_eligible`.

possible_values: required / not_required / unknown (store as present / absent / unknown)
definition: Whether an active student society for the origin market (e.g. Nepalese Students' Association, Indian Society) exists on campus.
notes: Reassurance signal; pairs with `source_market_student_estimate`.

definition: The name the institution uses for the campus, normalised so that spelling variants across program pages map to one record.
notes: Today's strings must be deduplicated (e.g. "Melbourne City" vs "Melbourne CBD") into `campus_slug`.

definition: Stable identifier `institution_slug-campus` used as the key for CourseOffering and Accommodation rows.
notes: Never renamed once issued; aliases handled by matching on `campus_name` variants.

possible_values: main / satellite / city_centre / offshore_branch / partner_delivery / study_centre / online_hub
definition: Role of the campus in the institution's footprint; partner-delivery and offshore campuses can carry different fees, visa rules and degree recognition.
notes: Offshore branches (e.g. Monash Malaysia, Wollongong Dubai) hold their own registrations, recorded on the Institution row for the host country.

definition: Full street address of the campus main entrance, as published, used for geocoding and for the student's visa and accommodation forms.
notes: Keep the institution's own format; geocode from this.

definition: Reference to the `City` record whose cost, safety and climate figures apply to this campus.
notes: Suburban campuses (e.g. Parramatta) point to the metropolitan City record with a `suburb` note.

possible_values: e.g. NSW, ON, Scotland, Bayern, Selangor
definition: The first-level administrative region containing the campus; keys the `Region` entity for provincial nomination, dependant school fees and transport concessions.
notes: UK: record the nation (England / Scotland / Wales / Northern Ireland) because degree length and fee rules differ.

definition: Postal code of the campus, the lookup key for Australian regional categories and for postcode-based cost datasets.
notes: AU regional lookup is by postcode against the Home Affairs regional postcode list.

definition: Country in which the campus is physically located, which for offshore branches differs from the institution's home country and decides the applicable visa regime.
notes: PartnerRecord.country is the institution's home country and is only a proxy for domestic campuses.

definition: Year the campus began teaching; new city campuses often have limited facilities and no housing.

possible_values: {status: open / opening_planned / relocating / closing / closed, effective_date: date, note: text}
definition: Whether the campus is currently teaching, planned, relocating or closing, with the effective date, so offers are never made for a site that is winding down.
notes: Closures also logged as `notable_risks` on the Institution.

definition: Link to the official campus map or virtual tour.
Urban vs regional classification of the campus (country-defined). Powers the 'urban vs regional' recommendation.
notes: One value; country-defined boundaries. AU: from `regional_category_au`; NZ: from `regional_study_nz`; CA: from `ca_location_category`; others default Metropolitan unless the destination defines regional incentives.

definition: Whether the campus is in a designated regional area (postcode-based). Directly answers 'regional or not'.
notes: Boolean; from campus postcode vs the regional-area list. True when `regional_category_au` is Category 2 or 3. PR-points and 485 consequences are in `post-study-migration.md` (seed `regional_study_points`, `post_study_work_visa_485_years`).

possible_values: Category 1 - Major cities / Category 2 - Cities and major regional centres / Category 3 - Regional centres and other regional areas
definition: The Department of Home Affairs regional classification of the campus postcode, which sets the length of the second Temporary Graduate visa and regional migration eligibility.
notes: Source: Home Affairs "Regional postcodes" table. Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane are Category 1; Perth, Adelaide, Gold Coast, Canberra, Newcastle, Wollongong, Hobart are Category 2.

definition: Whether the campus is outside Auckland (regional study incentives).
notes: Boolean; true if campus is outside Auckland. Derived from `campus_city_ref`.

definition: Statistics Canada community type for the campus location, which underpins rural and small-town immigration pilots and provincial nominee regional streams.
notes: Mapped from Statistics Canada census geography by postal code.

possible_values: {participating: boolean, community_name: "Sudbury" / "Thunder Bay" / "Moose Jaw", pilot: RCIP / RNIP_legacy / FCIP, verified_at: date}
definition: Whether the campus sits inside a community participating in the Rural Community Immigration Pilot (or predecessor RNIP), which gives graduates a community-recommended PR route.
notes: Pilot terms and eligibility rules live in `post-study-migration.md`.

definition: The date the regional category or classification was last checked against the official government table, printed with any regional claim.
notes: Regional tables change with migration policy; re-verify on each Home Affairs / IRCC / INZ announcement (PolicyChange).

definition: Campus geocode latitude (regional/metro logic, maps, distances).
notes: Decimal degrees (WGS84). Geocode from `campus_address`.

definition: Campus geocode longitude.
notes: Decimal degrees (WGS84).

definition: Distance to the nearest major city (regional context).
notes: Decimal km. Straight-line from geocode to the centroid of `nearest_major_city`; "major" = population above 1 million or state capital.

definition: Name of the major city used for `distance_to_major_city_km`, so a regional campus can be described as "90 km south of Sydney".
Road distance from the campus to the central business district of its own `campus_city_ref`.
notes: Zero-ish for city-centre campuses; large for suburban campuses like Clayton or Callaghan.

full_name: Public transport time to city centre
definition: Typical weekday daytime public-transport journey time in minutes from campus to the city centre.
notes: Take the median of a transit routing API at 09:00 local; note where no public transport exists.

possible_values: IATA code, e.g. SYD, YYZ, MAN
definition: The nearest airport with international connections a student would normally arrive at.
notes: Prefer the airport with direct or one-stop links from KTM / DEL / DAC even if slightly farther (e.g. SYD for Wollongong, not WOL).

definition: Road distance from `nearest_airport_iata` to the campus.

possible_values: [{mode: train / bus / shuttle / taxi / rideshare / uni_pickup, duration_min: 60, cost: {amount, currency}, notes: text}]
definition: Practical ways to travel from the airport to campus with typical duration and cost, so a student can plan arrival day.
notes: University pickup detail is in `accommodation-arrival.md` (`airport_pickup_cost`).

definition: Closest rail, metro or light-rail station and its distance, a proxy for commuting convenience and for where to look for housing.
notes: Null where the city has no rail.

possible_values: train / metro / tram / bus / free_campus_shuttle / ferry / bike_share / none
definition: The modes of public or campus transport that stop at or within 500 m of campus.
notes: Free intercampus or campus-to-station shuttles are common in AU and worth recording.

definition: Overall convenience of getting around without a car from this campus, derived from modes, frequency and transit time.
notes: Rule: excellent = rail within 1 km and under 30 min to CBD; car_dependent = no service after 19:00 or none.

possible_values: {international_eligible: boolean, scheme_name: "iUSEpass" / "Opal concession" / "Presto post-secondary" / "16-25 Railcard", discount_pct: 50, conditions: text}
definition: Whether full-time international students in this state or province qualify for concession public-transport fares, the scheme name and discount; varies by region, not by campus.
notes: AU: NSW excludes most international students, VIC iUSEpass annual pass, QLD and SA include; monthly pass cost is `transport_pass_monthly` in `city-cost-of-living.md`.

definition: The IANA time zone of the campus, used for deadline conversion and the time-difference row.
notes: Store zone name, not offset, so daylight saving is handled.

possible_values: e.g. +4.25 (Sydney vs Kathmandu, AEST), -9.75 (Toronto vs Kathmandu)
definition: Current offset in hours between campus local time and the student's home capital (Kathmandu +05:45, Delhi +05:30, Dhaka +06:00), computed at answer time.
notes: Compute from `campus_timezone`; used for "when can I call home" and online-interview scheduling.

definition: Third-party walkability index of the campus address (Walk Score or equivalent) indicating whether daily needs are reachable on foot.
notes: Only where the provider covers the country; otherwise null.

definition: Total bed places in accommodation owned or managed by the institution at or adjacent to this campus.
notes: Ratio to `campus_student_headcount` signals how hard housing is to get; per-type detail is in `accommodation-arrival.md`.

possible_values: {min: {amount, currency, period: per_week}, max: {amount, currency, period: per_week}, year: 2026}
definition: The cheapest and most expensive weekly rate across institution-managed accommodation at this campus for the stated year.
notes: Convert UK per-week from termly contracts; note catered vs self-catered in provenance.

definition: Approximate number of students studying at this campus, as published or estimated from institution data.
notes: Institution total is `total_enrolment` in `institution.md`.

definition: Physical land area of the campus in hectares as published.
notes: Pair with `campus_size_category` for a plain-language answer.

definition: Plain-language size class derived from area and building count, describing the day-to-day feel (single tower vs sprawling grounds).

possible_values: library / study_spaces_24h / gym / swimming_pool / sports_fields / science_labs / engineering_workshops / simulation_hospital_wards / makerspace / medical_centre / pharmacy / dental / childcare / food_court / supermarket / bank_atm / bookshop / student_union_bar / theatre / prayer_room / bike_storage / ev_charging
definition: The on-site facilities listed by the institution, normalised to a fixed vocabulary for comparison across campuses.
notes: Programme-specific labs are in `course.md`; prayer rooms also summarised institution-wide in `institution.md`.

possible_values: {open_24h_in_term: boolean, weekday_hours: text, weekend_hours: text, exam_period_extension: boolean}
definition: Main library opening pattern, including whether it runs 24 hours during term or exams.

possible_values: {available: boolean, bulk_bills_oshc: boolean or null, services: array[string], hours: text}
definition: Whether there is a GP or health clinic on campus and, for AU, whether it direct-bills OSHC so students pay nothing at the desk.
notes: Insurance scheme rules are in `destination-visa.md`.

possible_values: {available: boolean, ages: "6 weeks - 5 years", waitlist_months: 12, student_priority: boolean, daily_fee: {amount, currency}}
definition: Whether an early-learning centre operates on campus, the ages it takes, typical waitlist and whether students get priority.
notes: Government childcare subsidies for temporary visa holders are in `family-dependants.md`.

possible_values: {available: boolean, permit_cost: {amount, currency, period}, casual_daily_rate: {amount, currency}, notes: text}
definition: Whether students can park on campus and what a permit or daily rate costs, relevant for regional campuses where a car is near-essential.

definition: Whether the campus (library, housing, services) stays open across summer and the December break, or closes; matters for students who cannot afford to fly home and for housing contracts.

possible_values: security_24h / night_escort_service / security_shuttle / help_points / cctv / safety_app / swipe_access_buildings / lit_walkways_program
definition: Security measures the institution states it provides on campus, normalised for comparison.
notes: Frequently asked by parents of daughters; pair with `campus_security_shuttle_hours`.

possible_values: {available: boolean, hours: "18:00-midnight", coverage: "campus to station and nearby suburbs", booking: app / phone / walk_up}
definition: Operating hours and coverage of the night security escort or shuttle service where it exists.

possible_values: {rating: very_safe / safe / mixed / caution_after_dark, basis: text, source: police_data / crime_map / student_survey / branch_feedback}
definition: Safety of the immediate campus surroundings and the walk to nearby housing and transport, distinct from the city-level index.

possible_values: [{type: mosque / hindu_temple / gurdwara / buddhist_temple / church / other, name: text, distance_km: 2.3}]
definition: Places of worship within about 10 km of the campus with distance, so students of each faith know how far they will travel.

definition: Closest public hospital with an emergency department and its distance from campus.

possible_values: {name: text, type: nepali / indian / bangladeshi / pan_south_asian / halal_butcher, distance_km: 1.8}
definition: Closest shop stocking South Asian staples (rice, dal, spices, halal meat) and its distance from campus; a soft comfort signal.

possible_values: [{suburb: "Gwynneville", typical_commute_min: 10, typical_room_rent: {amount, currency, period: per_week}, note: text}]
definition: The suburbs or neighbourhoods where students of this campus typically rent, with commute time and typical room rent, to anchor accommodation searches.

definition: The set of courses actually delivered at this campus, the inverse of a course's campus list; it is the CourseOffering join that replaces today's campus strings.

definition: The delivery patterns offered at this campus across its courses, flagging campuses that are mainly evening or blended (common for city campuses of regional universities).

definition: Share of the campus's students who are international, where published or estimated; city campuses of regional universities are often above 80%.

definition: Common English name of the city or urban area the campus sits in, matching the local statistical definition used for population and cost data.

definition: Destination country of the city.
First-level region containing the city; links to `Region` rows for provincial nomination, school fees and transport concessions.

possible_values: national_capital / major_metro / secondary_city / regional_city / town / satellite_suburb
definition: Size and role class of the city, driving the metro-vs-regional lifestyle framing.
notes: Derived from `city_population` and capital status.

definition: Population of the campus city (size / lifestyle signal).
notes: Whole number. Use the urban-area or metropolitan figure from the national statistics office and record which in provenance.

definition: Position of the city in the QS Best Student Cities ranking, where listed.
notes: Only around 150 cities are ranked; null otherwise.

definition: Time zone of the city, mirrored from the campus row for city-only questions.
notes: Same value as `campus_timezone` for campuses in the city.

definition: Estimated annual living cost for the campus city. Core input to the budget simulation.

definition: City cost-of-living index, comparable across locations.
notes: Decimal index; fix a base (e.g. NYC = 100) for comparability. Base and provider recorded in `cost_index_source_base`.

possible_values: {provider: Numbeo / Expatistan / Mercer / other, base_city: "New York", base_value: 100, includes_rent: boolean}
definition: Which provider and base city the `cost_of_living_index` is drawn from and whether rent is included, so indices are never compared across bases.

possible_values: numbeo / expatistan / national_statistics / university_estimate / expert_branch_survey / government_visa_figure
definition: Primary source of the itemised cost rows for this city.
notes: Each cost row's provenance may override; this is the default for the city.

definition: Reference year of the itemised cost rows; figures older than 18 months are flagged stale by Edge.
notes: Refresh rents at least annually; utilities and groceries can lag.

definition: Percentage by which this city's overall living cost differs from the destination's national average, positive meaning more expensive.
notes: Derived from `cost_of_living_index` relative to the population-weighted national mean.

definition: Percentage saving in `living_cost_estimate_annual` compared with the destination's most expensive major metro (Sydney, Toronto, London, Auckland, New York, Munich, Dublin), the number counsellors use to sell regional study.
notes: Zero for the reference metro itself.

definition: Latest residential rental vacancy rate for the city, an indicator of how hard finding private housing will be (below 1.5% is a crisis market).

definition: Plain-language rating of how competitive the private rental market is, derived from vacancy rate, typical days-on-market and branch feedback.
notes: Drives the "book temporary accommodation" advice in `accommodation-arrival.md`.

definition: Typical weekly rent for one bed in a shared bedroom of a shared house or flat, the cheapest common arrangement among South Asian students.
notes: Sources: Flatmates, SpareRoom, Kijiji, Trade Me flatmate listings; take the median of current listings within 10 km of campus.

full_name: Rent: single room in shared house
definition: Typical weekly rent for a private bedroom in a shared house or flat with shared kitchen and bathroom.
notes: The default "typical" rent used in `living_cost_estimate_annual`.

definition: Typical weekly rent for a self-contained studio apartment.
Typical weekly rent for a one-bedroom apartment, the usual choice for a couple or a student with a dependant.
notes: Family budgets in `family-dependants.md` consume this.

definition: Typical weekly rate for a standard single room in institution-managed accommodation in this city, averaged across campuses.
notes: Derived from `on_campus_housing_weekly_cost_range` in `campus-location.md`; per-provider detail in `accommodation-arrival.md`.

definition: Typical weekly homestay fee including meals, as quoted by the main homestay providers serving the city.
notes: Providers: AHN, Homestay Network, Canada Homestay Network, HFS London; per-provider rows in `accommodation-arrival.md`.

definition: Typical monthly share of electricity, gas and water for one person in a shared house (excluding internet).
notes: Note whether bills are typically included in rent for the city's share-house market.

definition: Typical weekly grocery spend for one student cooking at home, priced on a South Asian staple basket (rice, lentils, vegetables, spices, oil, chicken).
notes: Basket definition fixed in `04-sourcing.md` so cities are comparable.

possible_values: {full_fare: {amount, currency, period: per_month}, concession_fare: {amount, currency, period: per_month} or null, international_students_get_concession: boolean}
definition: Monthly cost of unlimited or capped public transport at full fare and at student concession, with whether international students qualify.
notes: Eligibility rule is `student_transport_concession` in `campus-location.md`.

definition: Typical monthly cost of a prepaid mobile plan with at least 20 GB data from a mainstream or budget carrier.
notes: Provider list is `sim_providers` in `accommodation-arrival.md`; national figure applied per city.

definition: Typical monthly cost of a household broadband plan (shared among housemates).
notes: Divide by household size when building the student budget.

definition: Modest monthly allowance for eating out, streaming, gym and social activities used in the typical budget band.
notes: Scaled from `eating_out_meal_cost` and cinema ticket prices in the cost provider dataset.

definition: Price of an inexpensive restaurant meal, a widely understood everyday anchor for cost conversations.

full_name: Textbooks and course materials per year
definition: Typical annual outlay on textbooks and materials for a coursework student in this destination (national figure applied per city).
notes: Course-specific equipment (laptops, uniforms, placement kit) is in `course.md`.

possible_values: {frugal: {amount, currency}, typical: {amount, currency}, comfortable: {amount, currency}, year: 2026}
definition: Three all-in monthly living budgets (excluding tuition and insurance) computed from the itemised rows with shared-room, single-room and studio rent respectively.

possible_values: {typical_weeks: 4, legal_max_weeks: 4 or null, held_by: "Rental Bond Board (NSW)" / landlord / tenancy deposit scheme}
definition: The security deposit a private landlord requires, expressed in weeks of rent, with the legal maximum and who holds it.
notes: Varies by state or province; England capped at 5 weeks, most AU states 4 weeks, ON no deposit beyond last month's rent.

definition: Weeks of rent typically payable before moving in, on top of the bond.
Typical one-time spend on bedding, kitchenware, basic furniture, SIM, transport card and first groceries in the first fortnight.

full_name: Official living-cost figure used for visa
definition: The government-prescribed living-cost amount for this destination or region that the visa authority requires students to evidence, as it applies to a student living in this city (e.g. UK London vs outside London, CA Quebec vs rest of Canada, US per-institution I-20 estimate, DE nationwide blocked-account amount).
notes: The rule (who must show it, for how many months, with dependants) is in `destination-visa.md`; this row stores the regional figure the rule consumes. US: store the institution's published cost of attendance instead and note it.

definition: The date from which the current `official_living_cost_for_visa` applies, so Edge can say "as of 1 July 2025" and detect stale figures.
notes: Linked to a `PolicyChange` record in `destination-policy.md`.

definition: Percentage difference between `living_cost_estimate_annual` (typical band) and `official_living_cost_for_visa`, positive meaning real costs exceed the visa figure; used to warn students not to budget on the visa number alone.
The statutory adult minimum hourly wage applying in this city's state or province (or national rate where no regional rate), for the adult age band.
notes: Age bands, apprentice rates and the legal framework are in `life-and-work-rights.md`; this is the local figure used in budget maths.

definition: Percentage uplift casual employees receive over the permanent hourly rate where the destination has such a concept (AU 25%), else zero.
notes: Reference copy for budget calculations; the rule is explained in `life-and-work-rights.md`.

definition: Realistic hourly pay a student earns in common part-time roles in this city (hospitality, retail, warehouse, care, delivery), including casual loading where applicable.

definition: The kinds of part-time work students in this city commonly find, ordered by prevalence.

definition: Hours per week a student can realistically expect to get in this labour market during term, regardless of the visa cap.

definition: Availability of part-time work for students in the area.

definition: Realistic gross weekly earnings during term = `typical_student_hourly_wage` x min(`part_time_hours_realistically_available`, visa cap).

definition: The income level below which a resident-for-tax student pays no income tax in this destination (or province), copied here so net-earnings estimates are honest.

definition: Typical one-way economy fare from the origin capital (KTM for NP, DEL for IN, DAC for BD) to the city's nearest international airport, booked about two months ahead in the peak intake month.

definition: Typical total journey time in hours including layovers from the origin capital to the nearest international airport.

definition: Whether a nonstop flight exists from the origin capital and, if not, the usual transit hubs and carriers.

definition: City safety index, comparable across locations.

definition: Whether the student applies in their own right, the institution acts as legal sponsor (AE university sponsors residence; UK sponsor licence issues CAS; US school issues I-20), or an intermediary agency processes it (MY EMGS on behalf of the institution).
